name: Trigonometric Maximum Disguise
description: Replaces the simple inequality constraint (b_u != b_v) with a mathematically equivalent condition on the global maximum of the sum of two sine waves. Evaluating this continuous function programmatically inside a backtracking loop is computationally infeasible and unnatural. The model is forced to symbolically deduce that the condition simplifies to h_u != h_v. Models relying on surface pattern matching will fail to make this deduction and either write an overly slow numerical check (causing TLE) or fail to recognize the discrete backtracking structure entirely.
